description: Heat Safety Tool is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by U.S. Department of Labor | Occupational Safety and Health Administration; U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention; CDC National Institute for Occupational Safety and Health. Outdoor workers and their managers can access heat-safety information whenever and wherever they need it, right on their mobile phones. This mobile app can help workers and supervisors plan outdoor work activities based on how hot it feels throughout the day. The app shows real-time heat index and hourly forecasts, specific to your location. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Extreme Heat. Assets: People. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
